description: This file contains the 'Module' class within the OpenCart admin extension controllers, responsible for managing extension modules, including listing, installing, uninstalling, adding, and deleting modules.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Controller class for managing extension modules in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that sets the response output to the list of modules.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the list of extension modules, including their statuses and actions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process for an extension module, including permission checks, adding language entries, registering autoload paths, and creating module entries.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation of a module, including permission checks, removing extensions and modules entries, and calling related uninstall logic.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new module instance based on posted data, permissions, and language entries, then outputs a JSON result.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a module instance specified via request data, ensuring permissions, then outputs a JSON result.
